title: Zest: the graphical scripting language in ZAP
description: Zest's history with ZAP: a Zest add-on in zap-extensions from 2013, script engine support in the core, its own project in 2019, and Zest script chains in the Automation Framework.

chapters.title: The Zest add-on begins, 2013
chapters.text: On 2013-03-29 zap-extensions has "First version of Zest add-on", followed by "Added Zest" (2013-04-03) and "Started on the Zest help pages" (2013-04-04). The March 2016 newsletter describes Zest as "a graphical security scripting language from the Mozilla Security team".

chapters.title: Support in the core, 2013 and 2014
chapters.text: zaproxy has "Allow scripts to override interfaces (Zest support)" (2013-08-06) and "Added initial Zest templates" (2013-08-14). On 2014-02-10 it has "Moved Zest scripts from core".

chapters.title: Authentication with Zest scripts
chapters.text: zaproxy has "Required changes to properly propagate session cookies during Zest Authentication" (2014-02-15), "Fixed issue with Zest based Authentication scripts" (2014-02-21) and "Issue 1411 - Missing authentication handling for Zest scripts called from scanner" (2014-11-18).

chapters.title: Its own project, 2019
chapters.text: On 2019-04-03 zap-extensions has "zest: relocate to its own project".

chapters.title: Options and chains, 2023 to 2026
chapters.text: On 2023-11-13 zap-extensions has "jython, zest: Move options under "Scripts" node". The scripts add-on changelog for 45.18.0 (2026-03-31) lists support for "Executing a chain of one or more Zest standalone scripts using the chain parameter" in the Automation Framework Script job, and 45.20.0 (2026-07-13) lists GUI support for Zest script chains.
